title: Meta’s AI Comeback? Muse Spark Explained
description:
Meta just dropped Muse Spark, the first major model from Meta Superintelligence Labs - and it looks like a serious attempt to get back into the top AI race.

In this video, I break down what Muse Spark is, how it works, why people are paying attention, and how it compares to models like ChatGPT and Claude. We’ll look at Meta’s bigger AI strategy, the multimodal angle, reasoning features, and whether this is really the start of an AI comeback for Meta.

If you’ve been wondering whether Meta is finally back in the frontier model conversation, this is the breakdown for you.
